stories.title: India startup funding reaches $104.4 million
stories.summary: India startup funding reached $104.4 million across 10 rounds between 20 and 26 November 2026. While the total represents a 46.85% increase over the previous week, five transactions accounted for more than 93% of the capital. Seed-stage investments contributed just 6.6% of the weekly total.

stories.title: Green Aero raises $14 million for jet engine technology
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Green Aero has raised $14 million in a Series A round led by Crane Ventures. The aerospace startup will use the capital to expand engine-testing facilities and accelerate the flight qualification of transonic and supersonic drones. The company develops autonomous aircraft and military-grade jet engines.

stories.title: GIVA secures ₹90 crore from BlackSoil
stories.summary: Jewellery brand GIVA has raised ₹90 crore from alternative credit platform BlackSoil to support retail expansion and working capital. The funding follows a $100 million round announced less than a month ago. The company intends to use the capital to strengthen its omnichannel presence across India.

stories.title: Vegapay raises $10 million in Series A
stories.summary: Fintech infrastructure startup Vegapay has raised $10 million in a Series A round co-led by Vertex Ventures and Prosus. The company plans to expand its credit line offerings for banks and financial institutions. The round included both primary and secondary components for the fintech firm.

stories.title: Finnable raises ₹405 crore in Series C
stories.summary: Digital lending startup Finnable has raised ₹405 crore in a Series C round led by Bharat Value Fund. The company offers paperless personal loans ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹10 Lakh. It intends to use the capital to expand its lending portfolio and strengthen its existing technology stack.

stories.title: XEBO.ai raises $10.5 million for customer experience
stories.summary: Dubai-based XEBO.ai has raised $10.5 million in a Series A round from Emirates Growth Fund. The company plans to allocate 40% of the proceeds to develop voice-of-customer offerings and agentic AI capabilities. It is currently the sole investor in the startup, though others may join later.

stories.title: Jet engine startup Green Aero raises $14 million led by Crane Ventures to build combat drones - The Economic Times
stories.summary: Aerospace and deftech startup Green Aero has raised $14 million (about Rs 125 crore) in a round led by Crane Ventures, as it looks to scale indigenous jet engine development and build autonomous combat aircraft for military use.The round also saw participation from 3one4 Capital and Antler Elevate, along with

stories.title: DLI-backed C2i Semiconductors raises $15 million from Peak XV, marking largest funding round for Indian chip startup - D
Matters.AI raises ₹115 crore for enterprise security
stories.summary: Cybersecurity startup Matters.AI has raised ₹115 crore in a pre-Series A round led by Tanglin Venture Partners. The company is developing what it describes as an AI Security Engineer for enterprise data. The investment brings the company's total funding to approximately ₹175 crore.

stories.title: Every raises $17.5 million Series A
stories.summary: Media and software company Every has raised a $17.5 million Series A at a $110 million valuation. The startup operates a subscription service for individuals and teams covering work in the age of AI. IA Ventures led the round, which included participation from several media executives.

stories.title: FF News - The Fintech News Network
stories.summary: FF News is the fintech news network covering payments, insurtech, tradetech and capital markets.

stories.title: Mawj raises Series A for AI customer service
stories.summary: Riyadh-based Mawj has raised a Series A round to support its AI agents that handle customer calls and messages in Gulf dialects. The company claims more than 70% of customer conversations are resolved without human involvement. The exact amount of the financing remains undisclosed.

stories.title: Allocator One launches with $100 million in commitments
stories.summary: Venture capital fund-of-funds manager Allocator One has launched publicly after closing its flagship fund. The firm has secured more than $100 million in total commitments across its vehicles. It typically acts as an anchor investor, committing $2 million to $10 million to emerging fund managers.

stories.title: AidenAI raises $32 million in Series A
stories.summary: Princeton-based enterprise AI startup AidenAI has raised $32 million in a Series A round led by A91 Partners. The company develops a platform for enterprises to build, deploy and manage AI agents. The capital is intended to support expansion beyond its current presence in six countries.

stories.title: Zipher raises $53 million for data infrastructure
stories.summary: AI infrastructure startup Zipher has raised $53 million across its seed and Series A rounds. The company develops autonomous software for large enterprises to manage complex data operations. Founded by veterans of the IDF's Unit 8200, the firm maintains offices in New York and Tel Aviv.

stories.title: Maple raises $5.3 million for private AI
stories.summary: Maple has raised $5.3 million for an AI app designed to keep user data private from the company itself. The startup uses open-source code and trusted execution environments to verify its privacy claims. The company was co-founded by a former Apple engineer.

stories.title: Dulo raises $130 million seed round
stories.summary: Dulo has raised a $130 million seed round to build what it calls an engineering superintelligence. Founded by Sebastian Thrun and Adrian Aoun, the startup aims to use foundation models for hardware design. The company was founded earlier this year to apply AI to physical product development.

Iliad Partners launches $33.4 million VC fund in the UAE
stories.summary: Iliad Partners has closed its debut fund at $33.4 million. The firm says the fund marks its entry into the Middle East venture landscape, leveraging regulatory initiatives in Oman and the UAE. The region has seen substantial growth in venture capital investment in recent years.

stories.title: GEF Capital Partners closes India climate fund at $615 million
stories.summary: GEF Capital Partners has closed its fourth India-focused climate fund at $615 million, exceeding its initial target. The fund is 40 percent larger than the firm's previous vehicle and will target growth-stage cleantech businesses. Investors include pension funds, sovereign investors, and family offices from across the globe.

stories.title: Aeravti Ventures targets $32.4M for second India fund - Dealroom
VU Venture Partners launches India arm
stories.summary: VU Venture Partners has launched an India arm with plans to invest up to $1 million in startups. The firm, which counts OpenAI and SpaceX among its portfolio, intends to focus on Seed and Series A companies while bringing its investor accelerator program to the country.

stories.title: Kaszek closes $650 million fund for Latin America
stories.summary: Kaszek has closed its seventh early-stage fund at $650 million, surpassing its $600 million target. The firm says the vehicle is now the largest early-stage venture fund for Latin America. It will focus on artificial intelligence startups and compute infrastructure. The fund was capped despite strong investor demand.

stories.title: Aeravti Ventures announces first close of second fund
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Aeravti Ventures has announced the first close of its second fund, securing over half of its 300 crore rupee target. The firm plans to invest in 9 to 10 early-stage startups across food security, health infrastructure, and physical security with initial cheques of 6 to 10 crore.

stories.summary: US-based venture capital firm VU Venture Partners is building a pipeline of venture capital investors through its investor accelerator, Venture University, as it looks to tap opportunities in the country's startup ecosystem.The fund has backed startups such as SpaceX, OpenAI, Elon Musk’s neurotechnology startup Neuralink, and Anduril, which makes AI-powered

stories.title: CortexSpark Ventures targets 1,000 crore rupees for deeptech
stories.summary: CortexSpark Ventures has launched its debut fund with a target of 1,000 crore rupees to back Indian deeptech and artificial intelligence startups. The fund includes a 400 crore rupee greenshoe option. The firm plans to invest in approximately 20 startups with average tickets of 4 to 5 million dollars.

stories.summary: A Jefferies report highlights HCCH’s position in India’s non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) market, which was valued at around $15 billion in FY26 and is expected to grow at a compound annual rate of about 14% through 2031, according to the company’s draft red herring prospectus (DRHP). stories.title: PhonePe resumes IPO preparations
stories.summary: PhonePe has resumed preparations for an initial public offering that could value the fintech at up to 15 billion dollars. The company is targeting a listing in the first quarter of 2027 and is expected to file updated draft documents with regulators within 45 days.

stories.title: Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO opens
stories.summary: Mumbai-based catering and restaurant operator Foodlink F&B Holdings has opened its IPO. The company reported a net loss of 16.15 crore rupees for the six months ending September 30, 2026, following a net profit of 29.11 crore rupees for the full 2025-26 financial year.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO steps down amid investigation
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down following an internal investigation into alleged kickbacks. The probe reportedly revealed that executives took 150 crore rupees from sellers to boost visibility. This is the third such investigation at the company in less than three years.

stories.title: Walmart-owned PhonePe restarts IPO process after eight months, eyes up to Rs 1.5 lakh crore valuation
stories.summary: PhonePe, the Walmart-owned digital payments company, has restarted work on its initial public offering (IPO) and is targeting a listing in the January-March quarter, according to media reports. The company is aiming for a valuation of about Rs 1.2 lakh crore to Rs 1.5 lakh crore. The restart comes about

stories.summary: PhonePe has restarted its IPO process and is targeting a February-March 2027 listing at a valuation of $12-15 billion, sources told CNBC-TV18. stories.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down on December 4 after more than 11 years with the company. Chief Product and Technology Officer Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the firm until a successor is announced. Walmart acquired the company during Krishnamurthy's tenure in 2018.

stories.title: Exclusive: PhonePe back in talks with bankers to revive IPO, eyes $12-14 billion valuation - The Economic Times
stories.summary: Mumbai: Walmart-owned PhonePe has restarted conversations with investment bankers to revive its initial public offering plan, months after it put the listing on hold in March, and is likely to refile its papers soon, according to people aware of the matter.The Bengaluru-based digital payments company is exploring a valuation of

stories.title: WeRize reports profit growth ahead of planned IPO
stories.summary: Fintech firm WeRize reported a profit before tax of 44 crore rupees for the first half of the 2027 financial year. The company, which sells financial products through freelance advisors, says its profits have grown nearly tenfold over the past 24 months and plans an IPO within three years.

stories.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has returned to lead Nvidia despite reports of undisclosed romantic relationships with subordinates, including healthcare division head Kimberly Powell. Across corporate America, lying to the board about such relationships has reliably ended careers. The rules of corporate conduct appear to have developed an asterisk.

stories.title: NITES seeks AI job displacement policy
stories.summary: The Nascent Information Technology Employees Senate has called for a government policy framework to protect tech workers from AI and automation. The union argues that the industry should move forward without leaving the workforce behind. It is currently seeking consultations with stakeholders to address the issue of displacement.

stories.title: Union requests transparency in AI workforce reductions
stories.summary: The Nascent Information Technology Employees Senate has urged the Indian government to create a framework protecting IT employees from AI-driven job losses. The union wants companies to disclose why positions are eliminated and how many roles are replaced by technology. Transparency is being requested for all future workforce reductions.

stories.title: Startup founder remuneration rises in FY26
stories.summary: Thirty-two founders across 22 tech companies earned a combined 81.08 crore in fixed remuneration in FY26, a 3.4 percent increase from the previous year. Average pay rose to 2.53 crore. IndiaMART cofounder Dinesh Agarwal topped the list with 5.9 crore in fixed pay, followed by Lenskart cofounder Peyush Bansal.

stories.title: Campus hiring shifts toward experienced talent
stories.summary: Engineering and B-school placement season for the class of 2027 is underway. Companies are prioritizing experienced talent over freshers due to global conflicts and AI disruption. Placement teams are expanding recruiter lists to ensure students find roles, with compensation packages ranging from 10 lakh to 2 crore.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO criticizes rival AI messaging
stories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has accused rival AI leaders of using slogans like human control as a commercial pitch without addressing the risks of autonomous systems. Amodei described the current industry discourse as vibes-based positioning. The comments follow a report examining differences in how AI companies approach human agency.

stories.title: Drone industry shifts focus to intelligence
stories.summary: The drone industry is moving from aircraft specifications to service-led business models driven by AI and software. While flight time and weight capacity remain relevant, companies are increasingly focusing on the value delivered to customers. The next phase of growth is expected to be shaped by integrated technologies.

stories.title: Gen Z entrepreneurship grows on LinkedIn
stories.summary: The number of young professionals adding founder to their LinkedIn profiles has increased 383 percent since 2022. LinkedIn data shows that 94 percent of Gen Z respondents in India aspire to start a business. Seven in 10 plan to launch a venture or side hustle within three years.

research.title: Aligned Machine: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Embedding Similarity via Human Comparative Judgements
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Embedding models increasingly inform how people search, recommend, and retrieve information, yet we lack credible ways to test whether these similarity judgments reflect how humans understand meaning. Existing benchmarks typically rely on static, expert-labeled pairs with. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Brand Recall and Category Accuracy in Language Models: An Audit of 1,000 B2B SaaS Brands
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: A language model can name a brand without classifying it correctly. This study measures these outcomes separately for 1,000 B2B SaaS brands across 333 product categories. On Gemma 4 12B, with no external retrieval, category prompts. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CA-RAG: Constraint-Aligned Retrieval for Structurally Faithful Long-Form Generation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically optimises evidence selection for semantic relevance, whereas compliance-sensitive long-form generation also requires evidence supporting explicit structural obligations. Semantically relevant retrieval may therefore omit information needed for mandatory downstream clauses. We propose Constraint-Aligned. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Confidence scores for gated automation of large language models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in automated decision-making. However, LLMs may produce incorrect answers with high confidence, limiting their applicability in decisions that affect individuals and organizations. Reliable confidence scores. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
